name: Hybrid Sort-First/Sort-Last Parallel Rendering
aliases: Hybrid Sort-First/Sort-Last Parallel Rendering (Samanta et al.)
definition: A parallel rendering algorithm that performs dynamic, view-dependent partitioning of both the 3D model and the 2D screen to balance load and minimize screen space overlaps.
summary: Hybrid Sort-First/Sort-Last Parallel Rendering is a parallel volume and polygon rendering technique that partitions object and image space to balance load and minimize redundant pixel transfer.
